Battery & Charging  
An electric vehicle’s power is not determined solely by the power of the electric motor itself, but also by the power that th e battery is able to deliver. As such, the value cited for the car’s power is 
determined by the entire drive system.
Electric vehicles can be charged at public charging stations much like you would refuel a normal car at a petrol station. The se charging stations are powerful so they can recharge vehicles’ 
batteries rapidly. Most users, however, will generally use a home charger – a Wallbox – or an ordinary power socket. This charging takes longer, but hooking up to the grid is an automatic 
process and you can charge the batteries overnight, or at any time you are not using the car, without having to be present.
